description: This file defines the NextcloudServerDialog class, which is a dialog component for configuring a Nextcloud server URL within an Android application. It handles user input, validation of HTTPS URL, and communicates with a ViewModel to set the URL.

classes.name: NextcloudServerDialog
classes.description: A dialog fragment for entering and validating a Nextcloud server URL, extending BaseDialog with a specific binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog and retrieves the stored URL from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and returns the binding for the dialog’s layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures dialog UI elements, sets up button click actions, and handles URL validation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the dialog with an optional URL argument.
